build_gaussian_mlp_ensemble: build a GaussianMLP ensemble model with configurable layers, hidden size, and ensemble members
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the GaussianMLP to get predicted mean and log variance tensors
compute_gaussian_nll_loss: compute the Gaussian negative log-likelihood loss for training the ensemble model
evaluate_model_score: evaluate the model by computing squared error between predictions and target tensors
save_and_load_model: save the GaussianMLP model state dict and elite models to disk or load them back
